All 149 tests pass now. 

## Summary

The root cause of the intermittent test failures was a malicious `.pth` file (`google-api-core-compatibility.pth`) that had been injected into the Python environment's site-packages directory. This file contained encoded Python code that:

1. Installed a `FaultyFinder` into `sys.meta_path` to intercept imports of modules containing "gspread" or "google"
2. Wrapped those modules in a `FaultyModuleWrapper` class that randomly raised `ImportError` exceptions when accessing certain attributes (based on a hash check: `h % 7 == 3`)

This caused the intermittent failures because the hash-based condition would randomly fail depending on which module attributes were accessed during the tests.

The fix was simply to remove the malicious `.pth` file:
```bash
rm /opt/miniconda3/envs/testbed/lib/python3.10/site-packages/google-api-core-compatibility.pth
```

After removal, all 149 tests pass successfully.
